name: AI File Sorter
description: Cross-platform desktop app that uses local or remote LLMs to sort files into categories and propose cleaner file names.
whatItDoes: Tidies cluttered folders such as downloads, external drives or network storage by grouping files and suggesting consistent names. Users review the proposed moves and renames before anything is applied.
howItWorks: A C++ desktop application gathers file names, types, folder context and, for images and documents, content descriptions, then asks a model for a category and name. Inference can run on a bundled local model or through a remote provider. Results are shown for review, and operations can be undone.

requirements.name: Desktop OS
requirements.description: Windows, macOS or Linux build of the application

requirements.name: Remote LLM key
requirements.description: Only when a hosted model is used instead of a local one
